name: meltemi-diagrams
description: Diagrams as code for coding agents: write, validate and export Meltemi diagrams (flow sheets, sequence diagrams, C4 models, free compositions and whiteboards, and gantt charts) as reviewable .meltemi text that opens on a canvas. Imports Mermaid and PlantUML; exports SVG, PNG, PDF and an HTML player. Teaches the agent to choose the profile, keep a sheet readable and look at the picture before delivering.

interface.shortDescription: Draw diagrams as code your team can review
interface.longDescription: Meltemi Diagrams turns a description, your code or an existing Mermaid or PlantUML diagram into a .meltemi file: text you review in Git that opens on a canvas in VS Code or the web app. The skill teaches your agent the five profiles (flow, sequence, C4, free and gantt), how to keep a sheet readable, and to validate it and look at the picture before it delivers. Add the MCP server with codex mcp add meltemi -- npx -y @meltemi/diagrams-cli@latest mcp --stdio --folder . to let it check and preview the files of your project.
